question: Which of the following is NOT a classification of Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**State Private Sector Enterprises (SPSEs)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **State Private Sector Enterprises (SPSEs)** is not a classification of Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs).
 
• Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) are government-owned corporations or state-owned enterprises created by the Government of India.
 
• The common classifications of PSUs include Public Sector Banks (PSBs), C
